hero_description: Painting, drawing, and mural art. An evolving selection of original work by visual artist and art educator Nasrin Sharifi.
about_intro: A visual artist and art educator based in Ottawa, Canada.
about_description: With a background in graphic design, visual arts, and art research, Nasrin works across painting, drawing, illustration, and mural art. Her practice brings together different forms of visual expression.
about_teaching: She has previously taught art to children and adults in art schools. Her practice includes original work as well as commissioned creative projects.
education_description: Nasrin has experience teaching art to both adults and children in art schools. Inquiries about private art instruction in English and art education opportunities are welcome.
commission_description: For inquiries about original artwork availability, custom paintings, murals, creative projects or collaborations, contact Nasrin directly. Prices are provided by inquiry only.
